company_name: Qingdao SRI I Intellectual Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Qingdao SRI I Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd specializes in semiconductor front-end process equipment, which is critical for the fabrication of integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices.
summary: Founded in 2018, Qingdao SRI I Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd focuses on the R&D, production, and sales of key semiconductor front-end process equipment. Their offerings include atomic layer deposition (ALD) and ion implantation (IMP) equipment, which are essential for high-precision applications in various semiconductor fields.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Qingdao, China, and has R&D centers in Beijing and Shanghai.
regional_presence.Finland: The company has an R&D center in Finland, indicating a strategic presence in Europe.
